title: Equality and rigidity in the spacetime Penrose inequality

abstractEnglish: Equality in the spacetime Penrose inequality identifies the original initial data as a spacelike slice of a Schwarzschild–Tangherlini exterior, smoothly attached to its horizon, under the stated outermostness and decay hypotheses. We prove this in every spatial dimension n ≥ 3 for a strong-decay exterior class and for weaker decay in dimensions three and four. In dimension three the finite-component theorem forces a single spherical horizon and gives qualitative strictness for disconnected boundaries.
titleEn: Equality and rigidity in the spacetime Penrose inequality
titleZh: 时空彭罗斯不等式中的等式与刚性

details.overview: 该稿件研究时空彭罗斯不等式的等式情形。摘要表示，在所述最外性与衰减假设下，等式成立时原始初始数据可等同于施瓦西–坦格尔利尼外部时空的一个类空切片，并光滑连接到其视界。作者在每维 n≥3 的强衰减外部类中证明该结论，并在三维和四维对较弱衰减证明；三维中有限分量定理迫使单一球面视界，并对非连通边界给出定性严格性。
keyPoints: 在所述假设下，等式成立时初始数据是施瓦西–坦格尔利尼外部的类空切片。
结论在每维 n≥3 的强衰减外部类中证明，三维四维可放宽衰减。
三维中有限分量定理迫使单一球面视界。
